context.transcript:
Prashant, we're showing a film tomorrow evening in the courtyard outside the library.
Will you or someone else from IT be able to stay to make sure the projector and audio equipment work properly?
I can't stay, but Karima will be here.
I've already given her the instructions about when and where to set up the equipment.
That reminds me, there's a 50% chance of rain in the forecast.
What are your contingency plans?
Do you think you'll reschedule or...
We'll just move the event inside, into the library's community room.
I'll go find Karima now and give her a set of keys for that room, just in case she needs them.
Thanks.
context.transcript_translation:
Prashant, 我们明天晚上在图书馆外的庭院展示一部电影。
你或者IT部门的其他人能否留下来确保投影仪和音频设备能正常工作？
我不能留下，但Karima会在这里。
我已经给她布置了关于何时何地设置设备的指示。
说起这个，天气预报显示有50%的降雨几率。
你的应急计划是什么？
你觉得是重新安排活动还是……
我们只是把活动移到室内，转移到图书馆的社区房间。
我现在去找Karima给她那间房的一套钥匙，以防她需要它们。
谢谢。
